10182|264b8b9f.name: Rexxar
10182|264b8b9f.text: Greetings, $c. I am Rexxar, champion of the Horde, servant of Thrall, master to the beasts of the wilds.

11106|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Sikewa
11106|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

11317|1bfc2caa.name: Jinar'Zillen
11317|1bfc2caa.text: Hey mon! You've ever been diving deep in the ocean? I'll let you in on a little secret, eh. Deep in the ocean you can find bubbly fissures; they'll allow you to breathe air while underwater.  Let's keep this secret between you and me though, eh. I don't need no competition for me shellfish traps elsewhere... if you get my drift!

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3325|031480cd.name: Mirket
3325|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

3325|8fca8484.name: Mirket
3325|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3326|86b6c1ef.name: Zevrost
3326|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5398|87006095.name: Warug
5398|87006095.text: If you are here to fight, then good! You will see that the Magram are the strongest!

5412|84db224c.name: Gurda Wildmane
5412|84db224c.text: The centaur clans rule the wastes of Desolace. If united, they would be a terrible force. It is then good that the centaur clans are not united but instead bicker and war amongst themselves.

6726|c5ceacbe.name: Thalon
6726|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1369-progress.name: Warug
1369-progress.text: If you are not our enemy, then you will do what I ask!
1369-progress.title: Broken Tears

1795-progress.name: Strahad Farsan
1795-progress.text: Every $c should have a felhunter at his command. Though it be difficult to tame, the powers it brings to its master far outweigh the cost.
1795-progress.title: The Binding

1805-progress.name: Strahad Farsan
1805-progress.text: Yes, $N? Of what service can I be to you?
1805-progress.title: Tome of the Cabal

5421-progress.name: Jinar'Zillen
5421-progress.text:
I'll reward anyone who makes my life a bit easier... I enjoy doing as little as possible, mon!

Below the docks here in Shadowprey Village, I've many shellfish traps.  If you're kind enough to do my work and collect me my shellfish, then I'll reward you with something you want... get my drift mon?  For every five shellfish you bring me I will give you a fine Bloodbelly fish!
5421-progress.title: Fish in a Bucket

92743-accept.name: Warug
92743-accept.text:
As the strongest centaur clan in all the land, we deserve armaments with ferocity that matches our strength! 

Warug needs one most of all. A helm... no, a crown! A conqueror's crown! I heard legends of a fearsome conqueror across the seas. Go to a place they call the Badlands and seek out a crypt there. Return to me only when you have found the crown.

Do this for me, and I will reveal the Magram's greatest strength.
92743-accept.title: A Conqueror's Crown

92811-progress.name: Gorhak
92811-progress.text:
One thing that war has taught us: money is power.

All centaur in Desolace have come to an agreement to barter with intricately carved wood that shares tales of a centaur's own glory and conquests. It serves as the only reprieve from battle, and only the most level-headed are permitted to engage with other clans.

I have seen your kind trade in gold and silver. Worthless to us, as our totems are to you. Bring me some, and the Magram Clan will be pleased.
92811-progress.title: Economic Warfare

93225-accept.name: Gurda Wildmane
93225-accept.text:
I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.

I believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.
93225-accept.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93225-complete.name: Gurda Wildmane
93225-complete.text:
These are beautiful--I underestimated the creativity of the centaur. I never would have imagined that a race so full of brutality and cruelty would be able to appreciate stories told through carvings.

I suppose appreciating them takes way less effort than crafting them. Let me rephrase: I never would have imagined the centaur to be patient enough to carve out so many tales in wood. Where are they getting the wood?

In any case, speak to me when you are ready to make your delivery.
93225-complete.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93225-progress.name: Gurda Wildmane
93225-progress.text: Have you returned with the totems?
93225-progress.title: Carved Centaur Totems

94872-accept.name: Gurda Wildmane
94872-accept.text:
The fierce Magram are undoubtedly winning the war of territories at the moment. While we can all be thankful the clashes haven't erupted too frequently throughout the desert, every day their village just to the east grows a little bigger; their soldiers a little bolder.

I worry gravely about the consequences of an unchecked Magram clan, but I cannot deny their potential as an ally.

If you wish to earn their trust, offer this sack of totems to their quartermaster, but be careful.
94872-accept.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

94872-complete.name: Gorhak
94872-complete.text:
<Gorhak's eyes widen as you offer up the bundle of carved totems, but his brow furrows as his eyes flick back up toward you.>

I am no fool, outsider. This donation is not without cause. You want something, either from me or from our clan. I do not know what.

<With a single swipe of his hand, the quartermaster claims the bag as his own.>

And today, I do not care what your ulterior motive might be.

Welcome to Magram Village, outsider.
94872-complete.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

94872-progress.name: Gorhak
94872-progress.text: What business does an outsider have with Gorhak?
94872-progress.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

97265-accept.name: Aka'rai
97265-accept.text:
Ever strike a deal with a satyr, mon?

I have. How could I resist? The promise of power, knowledge far exceeding what any ordinary tome could offer... all alongside an eager and charismatic minion. What more could I ask for?

Bah, of course they would never bend the knee to a mortal. I bargained when I had nothing, only to be cast aside with even less.

Now, I want revenge. Revenge against the Hatefury. Raid their camp to the northeast! Stain the dirt with their foul blood.
97265-accept.title: Hate the Hatefury

98887-accept.name: Horde Warbringer
98887-accept.text:
The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands. 

Go, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98887-accept.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands
